{{Quote|First Jedi you've ever seen, sir?|The stormtrooper's last words, to Agent Alexsandr Kallus|<ref name="Spark" />}}
This '''stormtrooper''' was a<ref name="Spark" /> [[human]]<ref name="ECUC" /> [[Gender|male]] [[Stormtrooper|member]] of the [[Stormtrooper Corps]] five [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]]. During the [[mission to free Wookiee prisoners]] undertaken by the [[Spectres|rebel crew]] of the ''[[Ghost]]'', this stormtrooper was stationed in the [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] of the [[planet]] [[Kessel]]. He attempted to capture [[Kitwarr]], a young [[Wookiee]] [[Slavery|slave]], but was stopped by [[Ezra Bridger]], who fired an [[energy slingshot]] at him and sent him over a railing. While hanging on to a support pillar, he asked [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]], who had also been knocked over the railing by one of his own blaster bolts, which [[Kanan Jarrus]] had deflected into his cuirass, if Jarrus was the first [[Jedi]] the agent had encountered. Kallus responded by kicking the [[trooper]] off the pole into the mines below.<ref name="Spark" />

==Behind the scenes==
This stormtrooper is voiced by [[Steve Blum]], who voices [[Garazeb Orrelios]] in ''[[Star Wars Rebels]].''
